name: persistentList
description: List the persistent children (shell.spawn with `persist`) this browser profile started — running ones and the most recent exited ones (up to 64 records). Returns { shells: [{ id, command, logPath, startedMs, running, exitCode?, signal?, killed?, timedOut?, endedMs?, durationMs? }] }. The children live as long as the browser process (they run in the shell utility's job object), not past it. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
